[P2] Obtain maintainer agreement on the design

Rule 3, **Write a design note before the code**, remains unmet. The description now supplies the problem, alternatives and rationale, but explicitly states that the note was added after implementation and maintainer agreement is pending. The required design approval for this new lifecycle workflow is therefore still absent. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and obtain maintainer agreement on the chosen approach before proceeding with implementation.
